observation: The running login service configuration permits password-only authentication for an eligible ordinary local account. The separately scoped account has a public-key-only rule.
method: Read the native effective configuration in unprivileged configuration-dump and connection-context modes. Evaluated the ordinary local account and each literal account Match clause. No source-address, hostname or port Match condition was present. All parsed configuration files predate the running service start and its active command line carries no alternative configuration or option override.
scope: Authentication-method policy. Account secrets, actual password validity and successful authentication were not tested.
